notes:
Summary: Closed-lost — selected Together for private inference.

Key points:
- Use-case: real-time chat triage + clinical document search; high PII sensitivity.
- Initial intro call 2024-09-12 (AE Maya Chen). Prospect liked Redwood's batching/cost controls.
- Sep–Oct 2024: PoC scope agreed — run internal clinical reranker (embedding+rerank) + chat assistant.
- POC milestones:
  - 2024-11-04: Baseline latency test on hosted API (avg 220ms p50) — met initial latency bar.
  - 2025-01-20: Dedicated perf run (1k qps simulated) — Redwood perf competitive but cost ~20% higher vs benchmark.
  - 2025-03-15: Security review (SaaS + VPC) — Aurora required FIPS/KMS + on-prem option; red flags on audit retention.
- Security: Aurora's compliance team pushed for ISO27001 + KMS-backed key custody, explicit data residency (EU nodes). They asked for HSM/FIPS attestations.
- Competition: Together quoted managed private with FIPS + dedicated HSM in-region => Procured.
- Pricing: procurement team said 'budget reallocated to platform that bundled HSM and dedicated support' (quote from buyer).
- Internal champion: Dr. Patel (AI lead) initially supportive but moved to other priorities mid-2025; no strong exec sponsor remained.
- Last meaningful contact: 2025-10-28 — procurement confirmed selection of competitor; asked Redwood to send final security artifacts for audit trail.
- Open items at close: formal KMS attestation doc, runbook integration example, narrower TCO analysis. Se requested to archive.

Action items / next steps:
- Send final 'thank you' + archive bundle to Drive link.
- Add technical comparison notes to win/loss board (INF-sales-wins-losses).
- Follow-up in 9–12 months for renewal window / if budget returns.

Stated loss reason: 'Together's managed private offering meets our FIPS/HSM and in-region residency needs at a lower landed cost; execution risk lower for us.'
